__mr.hat__: At the depot, Bastian Hat had practised answering to his name. At Q-F17, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

Bastian Hat tried to describe the smell of Kesselby and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived. A letter from home reached Bastian Hat before dusk. Bastian Hat read it twice and slept a little easier. Victory at Grey Mill. Bastian Hat let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Dawn watch. Bastian Hat put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Pavel Chaser, grazed. A letter from home reached Bastian Hat before dusk. Bastian Hat read it twice and slept a little easier.
A clear shot from Q-F17. Bastian Hat grazed Isidor Mtzrn and slid back down below the parapet.

Bastian Hat was hit in the forearm at Q-F17. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Gideon Nkmcnamee of the Concord (@nkmcnamee). A letter from home reached Bastian Hat before dusk. Bastian Hat read it twice and slept a little easier.
Bastian Hat returned to Q-F17 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Bastian Hat and Dietrich Fred found a cat in the ruins at Hill 304 and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Dietrich.
The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Bastian Hat offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once.
Bastian traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
blakeyssss: The draft reached T-F13 on Day 9. Albin Blakeyssss was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Albin Blakeyssss reached up to fix a sandbag at T-F13 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Teodor Rozenband of the Concord (@oran__rozenband). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Albin Blakeyssss helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

The medic looked at Albin Blakeyssss's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to T-F13. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Albin Blakeyssss watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Albin Blakeyssss could not stop listening to it.

Albin Blakeyssss was hit through the chest at T-F13. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Dorian Castle of the Concord (@storming_your_castle). Albin Blakeyssss stood up to fix a loose sandbag at T-F13. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Dorian Castle of the Concord (@storming_your_castle).
Felix Blakeyssss came to the front because his uncle Albin Blakeyssss never came home. He carries a lock of hair in a matchbox.
The east wind brought the smell of the other trenches: smoke, lime and somebody's cooking. Felix Blakeyssss was hungry and furious about it.
Felix Blakeyssss had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Jonas "Spark" Jug was badly wounded.

Felix Blakeyssss was hit in the hip at T-F13. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Severin Poopdoop of the Concord (@poopdoop0224). Felix Blakeyssss was laid on a stretcher at the end of a long row outside the aid post. The bearers chalked a number on his boot.
Nobody could reach Felix Blakeyssss in time. He died on a stretcher by the aid post wall, one of too many waiting.
Another member of the House of Blakeyssss reached the line: Jonas Blakeyssss. He asked where Felix Blakeyssss had slept, then chose a different corner.
Two flares went up over Grey Mill. Jonas counted the seconds between them and the sound. It was a habit by now.
carcinogeneticist24: The new field cook gave his name as Emil Carcinogenet. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Emil Carcinogenet helped stack spare sandbags at T-F7. Nobody asked when they would be needed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil Carcinogenet. Emil Carcinogenet read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Emil Carcinogenet came off watch and could not say whether the last hour had felt long or short. He remembered every move in one patch of wire. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil Carcinogenet. Emil Carcinogenet read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into T-F7. Emil Carcinogenet has learned to walk bent double.
Blast from a trench mortar threw Emil Carcinogenet against the trench wall at T-F7. Ringing ears, a split lip, and no intention of leaving.
A round came through the loophole Emil Carcinogenet was watching at T-F7 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Bram Ordaz of the Hegemony (@matthew.ordaz12).
The bearers moved Emil Carcinogenet's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
Emil Carcinogenet spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to T-F7.
Emil Carcinogenet joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Emil Carcinogenet in the open at T-F7. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Benedikt "Mole" Neumann of the Hegemony (@schutze.neumann_). Emil Carcinogenet was killed outright at T-F7, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Benedikt "Mole" Neumann of the Hegemony (@schutze.neumann_).
Casimir "Ash" Carcinogenet came to the front because his older brother Emil Carcinogenet never came home. He carries a pocket Bible with a hole in it.
Casimir mended the hole in Ulrich David's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Ulrich says the patch is stronger than the trousers.
chaser143: At the depot, Silas Chaser had practised answering to his name. At Q-F17, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-F17. Silas Chaser has learned to walk bent double.

Silas Chaser was hit in the hip at Q-F17. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Bram Redactedword of the Hegemony (@redactedwords3985). Silas Chaser was hit at Q-F17 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Bram Redactedword of the Hegemony (@redactedwords3985).

Pavel Chaser arrived carrying the family name of Silas Chaser. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In Q-F17, Pavel Chaser listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at Q-F17 and grazed Pavel Chaser's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Bastian Hat of the Hegemony (@__mr.hat__).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Pavel Chaser is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet struck Pavel Chaser below the ribs at Q-F17. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away.
Pavel Chaser lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
No bed, no surgeon, just a medic with a kit and a lot of patience. Pavel Chaser recovered anyway and is back at Q-F17.
Pavel Chaser watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been.
Pavel had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Dietrich Drak was grazed.
collinjsampson: Arno Collinjsamps came up the line with a pressed cornflower and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Arno Collinjsamps wrote a song about the Hanging Bridge. Leopold "Crow" Napoleon wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Arno Collinjsamps kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Arno Collinjsamps tried to remember the price of a loaf in Northwick. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
Arno Collinjsamps dreamt he was back in Northwick, working as a railway porter. He woke up and said nothing all morning.
Arno Collinjsamps fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Yann Watt, grazed.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Oskar Ogre, gravely wounded. Arno Collinjsamps cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
Dietrich Jakegriffal cut Arno Collinjsamps's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
Arno Collinjsamps drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.
A flare caught Arno halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.
davidsonmarshall: Rafael Davidsonmars arrived on Day 4 as a replacement. The men in R-F2 had been fighting for 3 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world. Orders assigned Rafael Davidsonmars to work as a sniper. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

At the Hanging Bridge, Rafael Davidsonmars of the Concord and Cyril "Tin" Latsch of the Hegemony spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning. A letter from home reached Rafael Davidsonmars before dusk. Rafael Davidsonmars read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Rafael Davidsonmars tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F2 is up. Rafael Davidsonmars had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Gustav "Brick" Floooring crossed it, Rafael Davidsonmars fired. Gustav "Brick" Floooring was grazed. A letter from home reached Rafael Davidsonmars before dusk. Rafael Davidsonmars read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 is lost. Rafael Davidsonmars heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Rafael Davidsonmars put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
Rafael Davidsonmars heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot.
On sentry duty Rafael Davidsonmars watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.

Rafael Davidsonmars let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Gustav "Brick" Floooring was grazed. Rafael Davidsonmars lay behind a dead tree trunk at R-F2 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Cyril "Tin" Latsch was gravely wounded.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F2. Rafael Davidsonmars was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Isidor "Tin" Brayden of the Hegemony (@brayden27727).
Henrik Davidsonmars asked about Rafael Davidsonmars on arriving at R-F2. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

At R-F2 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Henrik Davidsonmars won the bet. Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver was grazed. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Henrik Davidsonmars answered to number 314. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Henrik Davidsonmars stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Henrik Davidsonmars had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Emil "Shadow" Ronnnie, badly wounded.
Henrik Davidsonmars kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
Rumour reached R-F2 that the war would be over by spring. Henrik Davidsonmars has heard it before. So has everyone.
A bullet went through Henrik Davidsonmars's sleeve at R-F2 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Dorian "Tin" Gtbeep of the Hegemony (@1gtbeep).
The medics cleaned Henrik Davidsonmars's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F2.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F2 and grazed Henrik Davidsonmars's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Wendel Jesus of the Hegemony (@jesus.gr9).
Henrik rejoined the squad at R-F2. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
dino_ramaci: Cyril Ramaci came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Cyril Ramaci watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper. A letter from home found Cyril Ramaci before the night shift. Cyril Ramaci folded it small and kept it close.

Cyril Ramaci opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Cyril Ramaci answered to number 742. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Cyril Ramaci read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Cyril Ramaci across the shin at S-C4. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Severin Ech of the Hegemony (@ech0_42). A letter from home found Cyril Ramaci before the night shift. Cyril Ramaci folded it small and kept it close.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Cyril Ramaci is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Cyril Ramaci was hit in the hip at S-C4. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic.
Cyril Ramaci lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
Cyril Ramaci returned to S-C4 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
A pump handle snapped off in Cyril Ramaci's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles.
Cyril slipped on the duckboards at S-C4 just as a bullet went by. He lost some skin from the fall and none from the bullet. Shot by Dorian Zag of the Hegemony (@grz_zag420).
ferg_haggis: By the time Oskar Haggis reached R-R7, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Oskar Haggis counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Felix Lowelleast was grazed. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Oskar Haggis wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

A supply man offered Oskar Haggis a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Oskar Haggis answered to number 854. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-R7, Oskar Haggis listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
A bullet went through Oskar Haggis's sleeve at R-R7 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Isidor Person of the Hegemony (@person116987345686).
Oskar Haggis came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
Oskar Haggis spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at R-R7 is closed now.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Oskar Haggis shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Anselm "Owl" Shadowizard, was grazed.
Oskar Haggis coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays an operatic duet nobody can translate, but something knocks once every revolution.
The gramophone stopped knocking after Oskar Haggis tightened a screw. The dugout applauded the repair halfway through an operatic duet nobody can translate, spoiling the best part.
Oskar watched a woman sweep her doorstep. He had forgotten that dirt could be removed permanently from anywhere.
gabo_kream99: Bram "Rabbit" Kream, a lamplighter from Greyhallow, was sent forward on Day 8 to fill a gap in R-S4. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Bram "Rabbit" Kream had orders to attack at dawn. He wrote back asking for artillery first. The orders were cancelled. Nobody knows which of his words did it.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Bram "Rabbit" Kream looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Bram "Rabbit" Kream had just lit a cigarette at R-S4 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Otto Baumann of the Hegemony (@tegan_baumann). The clerk counted the names twice. Bram "Rabbit" Kream is number 517 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-S4, Bram "Rabbit" Kream listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Bram "Rabbit" Kream was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-S4. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Tobias Flyerz of the Hegemony (@flyerz108). A single shot at R-S4. Bram "Rabbit" Kream sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Tobias Flyerz of the Hegemony (@flyerz108).
Henrik Kream arrived carrying the family name of Bram "Rabbit" Kream. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Henrik Kream reached up to fix a sandbag at R-S4 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Cyril Danielmcmena of the Hegemony (@danielmcmenamy).

A bullet hit Henrik Kream in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-S4. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Henrik "Shadow" Chauhan of the Hegemony (@prithvirajs.chauhan).
No bed for Henrik Kream yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
Henrik Kream healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
Henrik Kream had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Ulrich Hensley was gravely wounded.
Face blackened with soot, Henrik spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Silas Branden was grazed.
gastongimenez___: Yann Gastongimene arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Yann Gastongimene did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Yann Gastongimene tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Yann Gastongimene answered to number 830. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Yann Gastongimene watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Clement Kabu and Yann Gastongimene both swear they saw a ghost at the Chalk Pits. Each says the other screamed first.
A patient at the aid post asked Yann Gastongimene for a pencil. By evening, the wall beside the stretcher bore a drawing of a kitchen.
The wind tore a sheet of corrugated iron off the dugout roof at R-C2. Yann Gastongimene chased it halfway down the communication trench.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Yann Gastongimene lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
The patient has added a stove and three chairs to the kitchen drawing. Yann Gastongimene asks about each detail while changing the dressing.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Yann Gastongimene went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.
Before evacuation, the patient asked Yann to tear the drawing from the paper lining the wall. He managed it without losing the stove.
hunterplum: Silas "Bones" Hunterplum joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Silas "Bones" Hunterplum listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Across the wire at Hill 304, Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc of the Concord held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Silas "Bones" Hunterplum of the Hegemony held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.' News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Silas "Bones" Hunterplum during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Silas "Bones" Hunterplum counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Quentin Caden was grazed.
Silas "Bones" Hunterplum found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
Silas "Bones" Hunterplum borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Hugo "Saint" Guacamole was badly wounded.
Fresh from training, Silas "Bones" Hunterplum still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Walter "Parson" Roryhacon, badly wounded.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Silas "Bones" Hunterplum spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.

During a lull at the Sunken Road, Silas "Bones" Hunterplum called across from the Hegemony line. Anselm "Brick" Keggaholic answered from the Concord side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
Dawn watch. Silas put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Rafael "Saint" Simplepach, gravely wounded.
jurassic_guy013: Tobias Guy, a brewer from Brennmoor, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in R-C8. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Tobias Guy stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Tobias Guy found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Tobias Guy answered to number 634. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-C8 with the rations. Tobias Guy ate while listening to the revised orders.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Tobias Guy waited for that to change. When it did, Konrad Sebs was grazed. Shell splinters peppered R-C8. Tobias Guy picked three out of his sleeve and a fourth out of his arm.
The medic cut the last bandage off Tobias Guy's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-C8 the same hour.

A bullet struck Tobias Guy below the ribs at R-C8. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Henrik Sergiootd of the Hegemony (@sergiootd). The bearers reached Tobias Guy at R-C8 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Henrik Sergiootd of the Hegemony (@sergiootd).
Otto "Lucky" Guy took the same post at R-C8 where Tobias Guy stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Otto "Lucky" Guy offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once.
Two men fed the belt while Otto "Lucky" Guy held the gun steady on the enemy parapet. When they stopped, Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman was badly wounded.

A bullet grazed Otto "Lucky" Guy's ribs at R-C8. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Hugo Faulerhund of the Hegemony (@faulerhund1215). A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Otto "Lucky" Guy aimed a step ahead and fired: Bastian "Whistle" Check, grazed.
Otto returned to R-C8 limping a little. The squad pretended not to notice, and gave him the dry spot.
kjoj_iv: Karel "Tin" Kjoj walked into R-R3 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Karel "Tin" Kjoj wrote to a sweetheart who has stopped writing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Karel "Tin" Kjoj took a wrong turn at two identical trench junctions. He decided the route needed names that could be remembered under pressure. The clerk counted the names twice. Karel "Tin" Kjoj is number 965 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Karel "Tin" Kjoj watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

A sniper's bullet hit Karel "Tin" Kjoj at R-R3. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Otto Baumann of the Hegemony (@tegan_baumann). The bearers reached Karel "Tin" Kjoj at R-R3 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Otto Baumann of the Hegemony (@tegan_baumann).
Casimir "Mud" Kjoj came to the front because his brother Karel "Tin" Kjoj never came home. He carries a tin of tobacco.
A bullet went through Casimir "Mud" Kjoj's sleeve at R-R3 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin of the Hegemony (@dependentkink_____).
The medic looked at Casimir "Mud" Kjoj's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-R3. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Casimir "Mud" Kjoj tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Casimir "Mud" Kjoj left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.
A bullet clipped Casimir "Mud" Kjoj's helmet at R-R3 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Benedikt Snake of the Hegemony (@jake_the_snake6424).

A bullet struck Casimir below the ribs at R-R3. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Emil "Ghost" Fuck of the Hegemony (@fuck271or6m). Casimir died at R-R3 before the medic could reach him. It was fast. It was the only mercy.
Another member of the House of Kjoj reached the line: Bastian "Crow" Kjoj. He asked where Casimir "Mud" Kjoj had slept, then chose a different corner.
larpinhimer1488: Arno Larpinhimer left a grandmother who prays for both armies behind in Tannenfeld and came up the line with his brother's pocket watch. The men noticed at once that he counts everything: steps, shells, stars.

A bullet grazed Arno Larpinhimer's ribs at Q-F20. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Karel Littlerattae of the Concord (@littlerattae). Arno Larpinhimer walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Three days with a bandage, and Arno Larpinhimer is back at Q-F20. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
In the fog a figure walked along the parapet of Q-F20. When Arno Larpinhimer challenged it, there was nobody there.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Arno Larpinhimer worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
Officers came to inspect Q-F20. Arno Larpinhimer polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.
Arno Larpinhimer fired at a movement across the wire at Q-F20. The man went down: Bastian "Bones" Lastyy, grazed.

A clear shot from Q-F20. Arno Larpinhimer grazed Oskar Littlerattae and slid back down below the parapet. A round went through the rim of Arno Larpinhimer's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Nils "Saint" Slevvinkilev of the Concord (@slevvinkilevra).
The bandage came off Arno's head today. His helmet no longer fits properly. He wears it anyway.
weeping.christian: The quartermaster asked Anselm Christian to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

A rat stole Anselm Christian's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier. A letter from home found Anselm Christian before the night shift. Anselm Christian folded it small and kept it close.

Anselm Christian and Marek Thephatrat tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. A letter from home found Anselm Christian before the night shift. Anselm Christian folded it small and kept it close.

A muddy dog crawled into V-F16 through the wire. Anselm Christian gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Mercy. The letter for Anselm Christian had a few coins taped inside. They would buy almost nothing here, but Anselm Christian kept them.

Mercy has learned to carry messages in a tin on its collar. Anselm Christian is very proud. Mercy is mainly proud of the biscuits. A thin letter reached Anselm Christian. Only five lines long, and Anselm Christian knew every one of them by heart before supper.

Anselm tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination. Anselm got a letter in a language only he and his family speak. Nobody else in the squad could read a word, and Anselm liked it that way.
